project.name: SALTY - E-commerce Website
project.description: My 1st project is an e-commerce website called SALTY, Designed and developed a fully responsive e-commerce frontend website using pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript. The project simulates a complete online shopping experience without relying on external frontend frameworks.
features: Dynamic Product Rendering: Implemented a custom routing system using URL parameters (URLSearchParams) to handle product search, category filtering, and detailed product views dynamically from a JSON data structure.
State Management: Developed a persistent Shopping Cart system using the browser's localStorage to handle adding/removing items and updating quantities across different sessions.
Interactive UI/UX: Built a custom JavaScript Carousel class, simulated payment processing modals, and added micro-interactions (e.g., "flying to cart" animation) to enhance user engagement.
Responsive Design: Utilized CSS Grid and Flexbox with a mobile-first approach, ensuring seamless rendering across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Performance OptimizationModern CSS: Implemented CSS Variables (:root) for consistent theming and maintainability.

project.name: Salty V2 - Full-Stack E-commerce Platform
project.description: Salty is a robust, production-grade e-commerce platform deployed on AWS EC2. Built with a Nuxt 3 frontend and Node.js backend, it leverages a dual-database architecture using MySQL for core transactional data and MongoDB for flexible product reviews. The entire system is fully containerized using Docker, secured with SSL via Let's Encrypt, and features an automated CI/CD pipeline for seamless deployments.
features: Full-Stack Architecture: Developed a responsive frontend using Nuxt 3 and a robust RESTful API backend with Node.js to handle seamless user interactions and data flow.
Dual Database System: Implemented MySQL with Prisma ORM for structured relational data (users, products, orders) and MongoDB for flexible, document-based data (product reviews).
Containerized Deployment: Utilized Docker and Docker Compose to containerize the frontend, backend, and databases, ensuring consistent environments from development to production.
Reverse Proxy & Security: Configured Nginx as a reverse proxy to route traffic efficiently between services and implemented Let's Encrypt SSL certificates (HTTPS) for secure connections.
Automated CI/CD Pipeline: Integrated GitHub Actions to create a continuous deployment pipeline, enabling automatic code pulls, container rebuilds, and deployments directly to AWS EC2.

project.name: SkillFrameX - Online Learning Platform
project.description: SkillFrameX is a modern online learning platform developed with Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript. The project focuses on providing a seamless user experience for browsing courses, reading blogs, and tracking learning progress. It features a responsive design and efficient state management to handle dynamic content.
features: Dynamic Course Filtering & Search: Implemented a robust filtering system using `useSearchParams` to handle search queries and category selection, allowing users to filter courses by name, description, or category with shareable URLs.
Interactive Hero Slider: Built a custom carousel component with auto-sliding capabilities, manual navigation controls, and smooth CSS transitions to highlight featured courses.
Learning Progress Tracking: Integrated a custom hook (`useProgress`) to manage user enrollments and calculate real-time course completion percentages based on finished lessons.
Responsive Navigation: Designed a sticky navigation bar with a glassmorphism effect, featuring a real-time search input and a mobile-responsive menu that adapts to different screen sizes.
Asynchronous Data Loading: Utilized `Promise.all` to fetch course and category data concurrently, optimizing the initial page load performance.

project.name: DevPortfolio - Personal Developer Portfolio
project.description: A modern, highly responsive personal developer portfolio built to showcase professional projects, skills, and experience. Engineered with the latest web technologies including Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4, offering a seamless user experience, optimal performance, and clean UI design.
features: Modern Tech Stack: Developed using Next.js 16 (App Router) and React 19, ensuring high performance, excellent SEO, and a scalable component-based architecture.
Responsive UI/UX & Styling: Crafted a sleek, mobile-first interface utilizing Tailwind CSS v4 alongside `tailwind-merge` and `clsx` for dynamic and maintainable utility class management.
Accessible Components & Iconography: Integrated `@radix-ui/react-slot` for building highly accessible, customizable UI components, paired with `lucide-react` for consistent and lightweight SVG icons.
Data-Driven Rendering: Engineered a dynamic content rendering system that fetches project details, skills, and galleries from a local JSON structure, allowing for effortless portfolio updates.
Type Safety & Optimization: Fully typed with TypeScript to ensure code reliability and maintainability, while utilizing `next/font` for automatic font optimization (Geist font family).

miniproject.name: Drinking Water Calculator
miniproject.description: A lightweight, interactive web application built with React, Vite, and TypeScript that calculates a user's recommended daily water intake based on their body weight. The application provides real-time calculations and dynamically formats the output for a seamless user experience.
features: Real-time Calculation: Implemented dynamic state management using React's `useState` hook to instantly calculate and update the recommended water intake as the user inputs their weight.
Data Formatting: Utilized JavaScript's `toLocaleString` and `toFixed` methods to cleanly format the calculated results into easily readable metrics (milliliters and liters).
Modern Build Tooling: Developed using Vite for an ultra-fast Hot Module Replacement (HMR) development experience and highly optimized production builds.
Type Safety & Code Quality: Leveraged TypeScript for strict type checking and integrated ESLint for robust code maintainability and error prevention.

miniproject.name: WeatherDash - Interactive Weather Dashboard
miniproject.description: A comprehensive weather dashboard application built with Nuxt 3 and Tailwind CSS. It provides real-time weather updates, detailed hourly and daily forecasts, and features an interactive map to visualize precipitation, clouds, and temperature layers.
features: Real-Time Weather Data: Integrated OpenWeatherMap API to fetch and display accurate current weather conditions, including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and UV index.
Interactive Weather Maps: Implemented Leaflet.js to render dynamic, interactive maps with toggleable layers for rain, clouds, temperature, and wind speed.
Dynamic Location Search: Built a custom search functionality leveraging OpenWeatherMap's Geocoding API to easily find and switch between different cities globally.
Server-Side API Proxy: Utilized Nuxt 3's Nitro server engine (`/server/api`) to securely proxy external API requests, keeping API keys hidden from the client and preventing CORS issues.
Responsive UI Components: Designed an intuitive, mobile-first interface using Tailwind CSS, featuring smooth horizontal scroll cards for hourly forecasts and clean list views for daily predictions.
